cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)
project(l0_v5_description)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

install(DIRECTORY meshes urdf mjcf launch rviz
  DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

# Keep this description package buildable as a separate checkout.
ament_package_xml()
set(APP_VERSION "${${PROJECT_NAME}_VERSION}-dev.1")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/version.py"
  "# Generated by CMake. Do not edit.\n"
  "APP_PACKAGE_NAME = \"${PROJECT_NAME}\"\n"
  "APP_VERSION = \"${APP_VERSION}\"\n"
)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/version.py" DESTINATION "lib/${PROJECT_NAME}")

ament_package()
